description: Orthology test of the C. elegans PDI family against human PDIs: does PDI-2 group with P4HB (P4H beta subunit) and PDI-3 with PDIA3/ERp57, the class carrying transglutaminase activity? Needleman-Wunsch with BLOSUM62 and affine gaps, implemented locally.
code:
# =============================================================================
# Iteration 3, analysis A
# GO:0003810 (protein-glutamine gamma-glutamyltransferase) is asserted IDA on
# pdi-2 citing PMID 12424233, a paper that isolated and assayed pdi-3.
# Nematode transglutaminase activity is reported for an ERp60/ERp57-class
# protein (PMID 9435226). Direct test of class membership:
#   global-alignment percent identity of each C. elegans PDI-family protein
#   against each human PDI-family protein, plus CXXC motif and ER-retention
#   motif architecture.
# Prediction if the annotation is paralog carry-over:
#   PDI-2 nearest human relative = P4HB (the P4H beta subunit),
#   PDI-3 nearest human relative = PDIA3 (ERp57/ERp60).
# All sequences fetched from UniProtKB REST. No local data files.
# Gotoh affine-gap Needleman-Wunsch implemented here because Bio.Align is not
# an allowed import in this executor.
# =============================================================================
import requests, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

WORM = {"Q17770": "pdi-2", "Q17967": "pdi-1", "G5ED07": "pdi-3",
        "Q9XW97": "pdi-6", "O45108": "ce-other-PDI"}
HUMAN = {"P07237": "P4HB (PDIA1)", "P30101": "PDIA3 (ERp57)", "P13667": "PDIA4 (ERp72)",
         "Q15084": "PDIA6 (P5)", "Q8NBS9": "TXNDC5 (ERp46)", "Q9H3N1": "TMX1"}

# ---------- BLOSUM62 ---------------------------------------------------------
AAS = "ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62_ROWS = """4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
B = np.array([[int(v) for v in r.split()] for r in B62_ROWS.strip().split("\n")], dtype=np.int32)
IDX = {a: i for i, a in enumerate(AAS)}
def encode(s):          # unknown residues -> -1, scored 0 against everything
    return np.array([IDX.get(c, -1) for c in s], dtype=np.int32)

GO_, GE_ = -11, -1      # affine gap open / extend, standard BLAST protein values

def nw_identity(sa, sb):
    """Gotoh global alignment; returns (percent identity over aligned columns
    with no gap, number of such columns, alignment length)."""
    a, b = encode(sa), encode(sb)
    n, m = len(a), len(b)
    NEG = -10**9
    M = [[NEG]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    X = [[NEG]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]   # gap in b (consume a)
    Y = [[NEG]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]   # gap in a (consume b)
    P = [[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]     # traceback: 0=M 1=X 2=Y
    M[0][0] = 0
    for i in range(1, n+1): X[i][0] = GO_ + GE_*(i-1)
    for j in range(1, m+1): Y[0][j] = GO_ + GE_*(j-1)
    Brow = B
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        ai = a[i-1]
        brow = Brow[ai] if ai >= 0 else None
        Mi, Mi1, Xi, Xi1, Yi, Yi1, Pi = M[i], M[i-1], X[i], X[i-1], Y[i], Y[i-1], P[i]
        for j in range(1, m+1):
            bj = b[j-1]
            s = int(brow[bj]) if (brow is not None and bj >= 0) else 0
            d = Mi1[j-1]; dx = Xi1[j-1]; dy = Yi1[j-1]
            best = d; who = 0
            if dx > best: best, who = dx, 1
            if dy > best: best, who = dy, 2
            Mi[j] = best + s; Pi[j] = who
            Xi[j] = max(Mi1[j] + GO_, Xi1[j] + GE_)
            Yi[j] = max(Mi[j-1] + GO_, Yi[j-1] + GE_)
    # traceback from the best of the three end states
    i, j = n, m
    ends = [M[n][m], X[n][m], Y[n][m]]
    state = int(np.argmax(ends))
    ident = aligned = alnlen = 0
    while i > 0 or j > 0:
        if i == 0: state = 2
        elif j == 0: state = 1
        if state == 0:
            aligned += 1; alnlen += 1
            if sa[i-1] == sb[j-1]: ident += 1
            state = P[i][j]; i -= 1; j -= 1
        elif state == 1:
            alnlen += 1
            state = 0 if X[i][j] == M[i-1][j] + GO_ else 1
            i -= 1
        else:
            alnlen += 1
            state = 0 if Y[i][j] == M[i][j-1] + GO_ else 2
            j -= 1
    return 100.0*ident/max(aligned, 1), aligned, alnlen

# ---------- fetch ------------------------------------------------------------
recs = {}
for acc in list(WORM) + list(HUMAN):
    try:
        j = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json", timeout=60).json()
        feats = [f'{f["type"]}:{f.get("description","")}'
                 f'({f["location"]["start"]["value"]}-{f["location"]["end"]["value"]})'
                 for f in j.get("features", []) if f["type"] in ("Domain", "Signal", "Motif")]
        recs[acc] = {"seq": j["sequence"]["value"], "len": j["sequence"]["length"],
                     "name": j.get("proteinDescription", {}).get("recommendedName", {})
                              .get("fullName", {}).get("value", ""),
                     "feat": "; ".join(feats)}
    except Exception as e:
        print("FETCH FAILED", acc, repr(e))
print("fetched", len(recs), "of", len(WORM)+len(HUMAN))

ws = [a for a in WORM if a in recs]
hs = [a for a in HUMAN if a in recs]
Mx = pd.DataFrame(index=[WORM[a] for a in ws], columns=[HUMAN[a] for a in hs], dtype=float)
cov = Mx.copy()
for wa in ws:
    for ha in hs:
        p, al, L = nw_identity(recs[wa]["seq"], recs[ha]["seq"])
        Mx.loc[WORM[wa], HUMAN[ha]] = round(p, 1)
        cov.loc[WORM[wa], HUMAN[ha]] = round(100.0*al/L, 1)

print("\n=== Percent identity (ungapped columns), worm rows x human columns ===")
print(Mx.to_string())
print("\n=== Nearest human relative ===")
for g in Mx.index:
    r = Mx.loc[g].astype(float).sort_values(ascending=False)
    print(f"{g:14s} best={r.index[0]:18s}{r.iloc[0]:5.1f}%   second={r.index[1]:18s}{r.iloc[1]:5.1f}%"
          f"   margin={r.iloc[0]-r.iloc[1]:+5.1f} pp")

print("\n=== Architecture ===")
arch = []
for acc, r in recs.items():
    nm = WORM.get(acc) or HUMAN.get(acc)
    redox = [(m.start()+1, m.group()) for m in re.finditer(r"C..C", r["seq"]) if m.group() == "CGHC"]
    arch.append({"protein": nm, "acc": acc, "uniprot_name": r["name"], "length": r["len"],
                 "CGHC_sites": "; ".join(f"{s}@{p}" for p, s in redox),
                 "n_CGHC": len(redox), "C_terminal_4": r["seq"][-4:], "features": r["feat"]})
    print(f"{nm:18s} {r['len']:4d} aa  CGHC x{len(redox)} {[p for p,_ in redox]}  C-term {r['seq'][-4:]}")
pd.DataFrame(arch).to_csv("table11_pdi_family_architecture.csv", index=False)
Mx.to_csv("table10_pdi_family_identity_matrix.csv")
cov.to_csv("table10b_pdi_family_alignment_coverage.csv")

# ---------- figure -----------------------------------------------------------
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14.5, 4.4), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1.3, 1]})
V = Mx.astype(float).values
im = ax[0].imshow(V, cmap="viridis")
ax[0].set_xticks(range(Mx.shape[1])); ax[0].set_xticklabels(Mx.columns, rotation=32, ha="right")
ax[0].set_yticks(range(Mx.shape[0])); ax[0].set_yticklabels(Mx.index)
for i in range(V.shape[0]):
    for j in range(V.shape[1]):
        ax[0].text(j, i, f"{V[i,j]:.0f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9,
                   color="white" if V[i, j] < np.nanmedian(V) else "black")
ax[0].set_title("Percent identity to human PDI family\n(Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap -11/-1)")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax[0], label="% identity")

x = np.arange(Mx.shape[1]); w = 0.38
for k, gn in enumerate(["pdi-2", "pdi-3"]):
    ax[1].bar(x + (k-0.5)*w, Mx.loc[gn].astype(float).values, w, label=gn)
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels([c.split(" ")[0] for c in Mx.columns], rotation=32, ha="right")
ax[1].set_ylabel("% identity"); ax[1].legend(frameon=False, title="C. elegans")
ax[1].set_title("PDI-2 and PDI-3 belong to different PDI classes")
for s in ("top", "right"): ax[1].spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
